title: Agentic Trading: When LLM Agents Meet Financial Markets
authors: Yihan Xia; Panpan You; Taotao Wang; Fang Liu; Han Qi; Xiaoxiao Wu; Shengli Zhang
key_contribution: Reviews 77 LLM trading-agent studies and highlights protocol incomparability, weak transaction-cost reporting, and poor reproducibility.
main_limitation: Survey lens rather than a validated final taxonomy; field still immature.
relevance_to_project_aegis: Core evidence for reproducibility and evaluation gap

title: AI Agents in Financial Markets: Architecture Applications and Systemic Implications
key_contribution: Proposes a four-layer architecture and Agentic Financial Market Model linking agent design to market outcomes.
main_limitation: More conceptual and systemic than implementation-driven.

title: When Agents Trade: Live Multi-Market Trading Benchmark for LLM Agents
key_contribution: Introduces Agent Market Arena as a lifelong real-time benchmark across markets and agent architectures.
main_limitation: Still early; benchmark coverage and real-world frictions need further validation.
relevance_to_project_aegis: Supports benchmark and continuous evaluation gap

title: TradingAgents: Multi-Agents LLM Financial Trading Framework
key_contribution: Models a trading firm with role-specialized agents such as fundamental sentiment technical risk and trader roles.
main_limitation: Performance claims require strict reproducibility and transaction-cost review.

title: FinRobot: An Open-Source AI Agent Platform for Financial Applications
key_contribution: Provides an open-source platform for financial AI agents, including financial analysis and decision support workflows.
main_limitation: Platform contribution more than formal evaluation theory.

title: FinMem: A Performance-Enhanced LLM Trading Agent with Layered Memory and Character Design
key_contribution: Introduces layered memory and character design for LLM trading agents.
main_limitation: Memory is trading-decision focused; broader thesis and macro memory remain underdeveloped.

title: Large Language Model Agents for Investment Management
key_contribution: Frames LLM agents for investment management and trading workflows.
main_limitation: Needs deeper reproducibility and implementation comparison.
relevance_to_project_aegis: Supports transition from trading agents to investment research agents

title: Large Language Model Agents in Finance: A Survey
key_contribution: Covers data analysis investment research trading investment management and risk management.
main_limitation: Broad survey; opportunity remains for investment research-specific gap map.

title: Large Language Models in Equity Markets
key_contribution: Reviews LLM applications in equity-market analysis including news financial statements sentiment and prediction.
main_limitation: Equity-task focused; less emphasis on full agentic research workflow.

title: A Risk-First Evaluation Framework for Multi-Agent LLM Systems in Financial Markets
key_contribution: Argues that multi-agent financial systems need risk-first evaluation beyond return and accuracy.

title: Evaluating LLMs in Finance Requires Explicit Bias Assessment
key_contribution: Reviews finance LLM work and argues that explicit bias assessment is necessary.
main_limitation: Bias discussion must be connected to actual investment-agent workflow.

title: ESMA / Alan Turing / ILB LLMs in Finance Report
key_contribution: Discusses responsible adoption of LLMs in finance.
main_limitation: Policy report rather than agent architecture paper.
